reason: Owner feedback: descriptions were naming accepted answers, including high-scoring ones.
policy: Descriptions define boundaries without naming accepted answers or aliases. Unavoidable character/series names in a prompt receive the minimum 1-point rating. Existing snapshots and scores remain unchanged.
